newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden/EMU debate to continue until 1997 - Riksbank.
newsitem.headline: Sweden/EMU debate to continue until 1997 - Riksbank.

text.p: Swedish Central Bank (Riksbank) Governor Urban Backstrom said on Sunday debate in Sweden about the country's participation in Europe's Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) would continue until 1997, when a decision is due.
"The Swedish parliament will be making a decision and I assume the discussion will carry on until this," Backstrom told a congress of Sweden' trade union confederation LO on Sunday.
Backstrom's comments appeared to be aimed at dampening speculation that Sweden might decide to participate sooner.
Backstrom said it was highly probable that EMU would occur in 1999 as scheduled.
"It appears that it is highly likely that a monetary union will be formed. My experience indicates to me that there is much ambition in Europe to adhere to the timetable," he added.
